key_insight: Fine-tuning the pretrained TimeSformer video model showed promise for identifying heart failure with reduced ejection fraction from apical four-chamber echocardiography videos.
clinical_relevance: This approach could support automated echocardiography assessment, but clinical usefulness remains unestablished.
method: Fine-tuned TimeSformer on the public RVENet A4C dataset.
Generated phase-aware clips capturing systolic and diastolic dynamics.
Used divided space-time attention, layer-wise learning rate decay, and multi-clip inference.
evidence_signal: On RVENet A4C, full fine-tuning outperformed classifier-only tuning and a 3D CNN baseline; the abstract reports no numerical performance metrics.
watch_item: Generalizability to independent clinical populations is unclear because the abstract does not report external validation.
paper_title: Domain adaptation of a video Foundation model for Heart Failure Diagnosis from Echocardiography
